FLINK-11853.title: Support POST for /jars/:jarid/plan
FLINK-11853.description:
Lots of HTTP clients (including the Java native client as well as OkHttp) enforce that a GET request cannot include a request body and change the request to a POST request if an attempt is made to send a request body.

While one answer would be to just request that people use a different HTTP client library, in some cases the potential for classloader conflicts may make this difficult. The easier solution would be to just provide a second end-point that responds to POST requests as well.

FLINK-12057.title: Refactor MemoryLogger to accept termination future instead of ActorSystem
FLINK-12057.description:
The {{MemoryLogger}} currently accepts an {{ActorSystem}} and uses it to determine whether the logging thread should be shut down.

For this purpose a termination future would be sufficient.

commits.message: [FLINK-12057] Refactor MemoryLogger to accept termination future instead of ActorSystem
commits.author: zentol

FLINK-12077.title: Introduce HashJoinOperator and LongHashJoinGenerator to blink
FLINK-12077.description:
Introduce HashJoinOperator to support all join type.

Introduce LongHashJoinGenerator to do some performance optimization when key is long using LongHybridHashTable.

HashJoinOperator and LongHashJoinOperator can be used in both shuffle hash join and broadcast hash join.

commits.message: [FLINK-12077][table-runtime-blink] Introduce HashJoinOperator and LongHashJoinGenerator to blink
commits.author: JingsongLi

FLINK-12087.title: Introduce over window operators to blink batch
FLINK-12087.description:
Introduce NonBufferOverWindowOperator: Some over windows do not need to buffer data, such as rank, rows between unbounded preceding and 0, etc. We introduce NonBufferOverWindowOperator to reduce the overhead of data copy in buffer.

Introduce BufferDataOverWindowOperator and OverWindowFrame: 1. Minimize duplicate computation in various OverWindowFrame implementations. 2. An OverWindowOperator can compute multiple window frames.

commits.message: [FLINK-12087][table-runtime-blink] Introduce over window operators to blink batch
commits.author: JingsongLi
